name: Explosion Breaks No Block
statusMeaning: Calls something that is on Kiln's roadmap. Parts of it may already run.
author: amotassic
description: A simple utility mod that allows you to toggle whether explosions break blocks (still cause damage) and whether explosions damage item entities.
roadmap: Minecraft's libraries and client API (0.2), Code next to data (0.3), Mixin (0.5)
evidence: Server-side mod: Kiln runs mods' code on Horizon's single-player server, not on dedicated servers.
